# Audifort Notebook (audifortus.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for Audifort, a 30 mL liquid dropper dietary supplement marketed to support healthy hearing and ear wellness in adults. Bottle label: serving size 1 mL, 30 servings per container; chromium (as chromium picolinate) 0.7 mcg (2% DV); a 200 mg proprietary blend of 22 items (maca, grape seed, guarana, African mango, eleuthero, astragalus, green tea, gymnema, coleus forskohlii, capsicum, grapefruit, Panax ginseng aerial extract, raspberry ketones, L-glutamine, L-tyrosine, L-arginine, beta-alanine, monoammonium glycyrrhizinate, GABA, L-ornithine, L-tryptophan, L-carnitine); other ingredients glycerin, water, organic lemon extract, stevia, xylitol, sodium benzoate, potassium sorbate, citric acid, natural flavors. The seller web page says 20+ components. Directions: shake well, 1 or 2 droppers daily. 6 bottle pack $49 a bottle ($294, free US shipping on qualifying orders); 2 and 3 bottle prices shown at checkout; 90-day money-back guarantee subject to the seller's terms; retailer named as BuyGoods.

IMPORTANT: Audifort is a supplement, not a hearing aid and not a treatment for hearing loss or tinnitus; no ingredient on the label is an established hearing nutrient and no study of the product is known. Not FDA approved (supplements are not). Sudden hearing loss needs a doctor the same day or next. Contains caffeine sources (guarana, green tea), ginseng, a licorice-derived compound and grapefruit extract; ask a doctor or pharmacist first with diabetes, blood-pressure, blood-thinning, antidepressant or thyroid medicine. Xylitol is dangerous to dogs. Adults 18+ only; pregnant or nursing people and anyone with a medical condition should consult a physician.

Not the maker's website. Contains affiliate links.
